info.name: Folder Albums
info.summary: Create Photos albums from existing folders
info.description:
Create Nextcloud Photos albums from folders you already use to organize your media.
Choose a root folder, scan its subfolders, select one or many folders, and create matching Photos albums without moving or deleting the original files.
Features: - Scan folders for images and videos - Select individual, multiple, or all discovered folders - Create one Photos album per selected folder - Optionally include media from subfolders - Skip existing albums or add missing media to them - Keep the original folder structure unchanged
info.author: Ahmad Kuhlmann Balkiss
